regressions: Model visibility and readonly views preserve the concrete list type.

Structured filters precede existing grouping, ordering and pagination clauses.
query_cost: Unique projections use one count query. Duplicate projections use a zero-row metadata probe and a count CTE after MySQL rejects the ordinary derived-table count.
